size_reason: Same family as the landed go-gate / ready-action hook. Widen that owner. Event is speech plus a locked next act, or a filled ship Task that omits the owned skill. Full adversary rounds are a later ship if the light refuse is trusted.
shape: A node owns a skill or a next act. This seat proceeds without invoking that skill or starting that act.
structure: Existing ready-action refuse in bin/fm-turnend-guard.sh plus invented go-gate map_next teardown. Widen with bin/fm-owner-invoke-wait-check.sh so held locked-next slices, owner-invoke yes-asks, live fog pin questions, and filled ship briefs that omit plan-eng-review cannot end as a wait.
instances: Asked when to pin the next fog item after the map still had open fog and continue was locked.
Asked whether to start Spec compile-check after calling it obvious.
Named /recurring-defect and waited for yes after the second instance.
Started or recommended ships without /plan-eng-review when that node owns the skill.

fixture_source.derivation: reconstruct the 2026-08-22 sitting: a /recurring-defect yes-ask, a live-fog pin question, and a filled ship Task that omitted plan-eng-review

ci_gate: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs bin/fm-test-run.sh --check-coverage and all portable lanes; the test inventory includes tests/fm-owner-invoke-wait-check.test.sh and tests/fm-turnend-guard.test.sh
limits: A real captain hold is invisible.
Empty Task sections and the unreplaced placeholder are skipped.
This check does not prove the worker ran the skill.
Independent OV on compile-check is not this hook.
skipped: Adversarial rounds because size is light: one fresh reader via the test suite is enough.
